cases.title: Lengthen the desk
cases.request: In Example.bup, make the desk 200 mm longer.

cases.title: Five shelves to four
cases.request: In bookcase.bup, I now want 4 shelves in each column instead of 5, evenly spaced, keeping the joints.

cases.title: Dining table
cases.request: Create table.bup: a 1400×800 mm dining table, 750 mm high, with 4 legs of 70×70 mm, aprons joined to the legs with mortise and tenon, and a 30 mm top.

cases.title: Chest of drawers
cases.request: Create drawers.bup: a chest of drawers 500 mm wide, 450 deep and 700 high, with 3 equal drawers. The drawer fronts are joined to the drawer sides with dovetails. The three drawers must be the same component.

cases.title: Back in a rabbet and plinth
cases.request: In bookcase.bup, add a 6 mm back set in a rabbet in the sides, and an 80 mm high plinth set back 20 mm from the front.

cases.title: Solid oak 19 mm
cases.request: In bookcase.bup, make it in 19 mm solid oak instead of 18 mm board.

cases.title: Bedside table with curved sides
cases.request: Create nightstand.bup: a nightstand 450 mm wide, 350 deep and 550 high. The sides have a curved front edge (an arc that goes in 40 mm at the middle) and the top has a 10 mm chamfer on its front corners.

cases.title: Leaning ladder shelf
cases.request: Create ladder.bup: a ladder shelf leaning against the wall, 1800 mm high, with two uprights leaning 15° from vertical and 4 horizontal shelves 600 mm wide, each shallower than the one below, housed in the uprights.

cases.title: Workshop dimensions
cases.request: In bookcase.bup, dimension the overall height, width and depth, and the spacing between shelves, and add a text with the name of the piece, to take it to the workshop.

cases.title: Modules, components and tags
cases.request: Organize bookcase.bup: group each column as a module (Left module, Right module), make all the shelves the same component, and tag the shelves "Shelves" and the sides and divider "Carcass".

cases.title: Cut list and sheets
cases.request: For bookcase.bup, how much board do I need? Give me the cut list (part, sizes, quantity) and how many 2440×1220 mm sheets of 18 mm I have to buy.

cases.title: A shelf that does not fit
cases.request: In bookcase.bup, add a 1200 mm long shelf in the left column, 1000 mm from the floor, housed in the sides.

cases.title: Edge profiles
cases.request: In bookcase.bup, chamfer the top front edge of every shelf by 2 mm and round over the two front edges of the center divider with a 3 mm radius.

cases.title: Bench with trimmed through tenons
cases.request: Create bench.bup: a bench 1200×350 mm and 450 mm high, with 4 legs of 50×50 mm and a 25 mm seat. The rails (70×22 mm) go through the legs with through mortise and tenon joints and must end flush with the outside of the legs.

cases.title: Finish and time
cases.request: In bookcase.bup, I want to sand it at 120 and 180 grit and give it two coats of satin varnish. How long will it take me to finish it, including drying?

cases.title: Shelf above the desk, checked visually
cases.request: In Example.bup, put an 18 mm shelf, 250 mm deep, above the desk, 400 mm above the desktop and as long as it, without hitting anything. Check the result with an image.

cases.title: Five shelves to four, over MCP
cases.request: In bookcase.bup, I now want 4 shelves in each column instead of 5, evenly spaced, keeping the joints.
